name: Decent Sampler
description: The free sample player, on the TrimUI Brick. Plays Decent Sampler instruments from the Brick's buttons or a MIDI keyboard, browses and downloads libraries from the Decent Samples store, and shows each instrument's own interface. Beta.
author: Decent Samples
features: Plays Decent Sampler instruments: the same libraries as the desktop plugin
The Decent Samples store on the device: browse, download free libraries, sign in to get the ones you own
Paid libraries work offline once the Brick is added to your account
Melody and Chords modes: play notes or chords in a key from the face buttons, with strum and arpeggio
Each instrument's own controls, from its interface
USB MIDI keyboards, and Bluetooth MIDI keyboards, remembered and reconnected
Libraries and settings live on the SD card outside the pak and survive updates
